description: This file implements functions related to the DNS NSLookup diagnostic process for the Broadband Home Manager Model (BBHM). It includes functions to start, stop, retrieve results, receive incoming DNS reply packets, and send DNS query packets as part of a diagnostic operation.

classes.name: PBBHM_DIAG_NS_LOOKUP_OBJECT
classes.description: Object representing the DNS NS Lookup diagnostic process, managing its state, control, and associated data.

classes.name: PDSLH_NSLOOKUP_INFO
classes.description: Structure holding DNS lookup diagnostic information such as hostname, DNS server, and diagnostic state.

classes.name: PBBHM_NS_LOOKUP_PROPERTY
classes.description: Properties related to the ongoing NS lookup, such as status, packet counts, and control flags.

classes.name: PBBHM_NS_LOOKUP_TDO_OBJECT
classes.description: Timer object used to manage timeout and scheduling in DNS lookup diagnostics.

classes.name: PBBHM_NS_LOOKUP_ECHO_ENTRY
classes.description: Represents an echo entry in the DNS lookup process, tracking individual query responses and statuses.

classes.name: PBBHM_NS_LOOKUP_QUERY_ENTRY
classes.description: Represents a DNS query issued during the diagnostic process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsStartDiag(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts the DNS NS lookup diagnostic process, configuring source IP, destination DNS server, number of packets, and initiating the process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsStopDiag(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Stops the ongoing DNS NS lookup diagnostic process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsRetrieveResult(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the DNS lookup diagnostic, primarily checking if the diagnostic info is available.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hXsinkObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Handles incoming DNS response packets, processing responses, updating status, and managing query entries accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hXsinkObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Sends DNS query packets to the specified DNS server for lookup diagnostics.
